name: Loop
author: kreyk29 (original game and levels); Arcade version by PodBox
help: Turn the pipes until every channel meets its own kind in the next cell: thick to thick, twin to twin, thin to thin. A network with no open end fills with its liquid; when every network is full, the level is done. Prev and Next move left and right, Menu up and Play down; the wheel steps through the pipes. Select turns a pipe. Fewest turns wins; time breaks a tie. After Loop by kreyk29, whose levels these are (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
